summary: The note describes the PT boat, short for Patrol Torpedo boat, a torpedo-armed fast attack craft used by the United States Navy in World War II. It was small, fast and cheap to build, prized for maneuverability and speed. Early in the war, however, it was hampered by ineffective torpedoes, limited armament and fragile construction, which restricted some variants to coastal waters.
one_line: The PT boat was a small, fast, torpedo-armed US Navy attack craft of World War II, valued for speed but limited early on.
